nodes.name: Traveler
nodes.base_description: The protagonist, an outlander from another world, searching for their lost sibling and trying to meet all seven Archons. Known as the Honorary Knight of Mondstadt.

nodes.name: Paimon
nodes.base_description: Traveler's companion, a small floating guide who often speaks on behalf of both.

nodes.name: Zhongli
nodes.base_description: Consultant of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, later revealed to be the Geo Archon Rex Lapis (Morax) in mortal form.

states.current_description: Zhongli is a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, believed to be a knowledgeable mortal with no memory of money. He organizes the Rite of Parting with Traveler's help, hiding his true identity.
Zhongli is revealed to be Rex Lapis, the Geo Archon, who faked his death to test Liyue. After giving away his Gnosis, he continues living as a mortal without his divine power.

nodes.name: Rex Lapis
nodes.base_description: The Geo Archon, God of Contracts, also known as Morax. He creates Mora and rules Liyue. Faked his death to test Liyue's readiness.

states.current_description: Rex Lapis is the living Geo Archon, ruling Liyue for 3,700 years and creating Mora, though he secretly plans to stage his death.
Rex Lapis is believed to be dead by the people of Liyue. He remains in hiding as Zhongli, observing Liyue's response to his 'death'.
Rex Lapis is revealed to be alive. He gives up his Gnosis to the Tsaritsa, ending his role as the Geo Archon and becoming a mortal.

nodes.name: Childe
nodes.base_description: Fatui Harbinger, the Eleventh. Loves battle. Helps Traveler initially but secretly plans to steal the Gnosis. Awakens the ancient god Osial.

states.current_description: Childe pretends to be a friendly ally to the Traveler, providing funds for the Rite of Parting while secretly planning to steal the Gnosis.
Childe reveals his true intentions, fights the Traveler at the Golden House, then awakens Osial. He is humiliated to learn he was deceived by Zhongli and Signora.

nodes.name: Ningguang
nodes.base_description: Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing, owner of the Jade Chamber. Ambitious businesswoman.

states.current_description: Ningguang leads the Liyue Qixing, hides the Exuvia, and invites the Traveler to the Jade Chamber to negotiate. She owns the Jade Chamber.
Ningguang sacrifices her Jade Chamber to suppress Osial, losing her beloved palace but saving Liyue. She then negotiates with the adepti and Fatui.

nodes.name: Keqing
nodes.base_description: Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, skeptical of divine authority and adepti.

nodes.name: Ganyu
nodes.base_description: Secretary of the Qixing, half-qilin adeptus. Fought in Archon War.

nodes.name: Signora
nodes.base_description: Fatui Harbinger, the Eighth. Previously took Venti's Gnosis. Collects Zhongli's Gnosis.

nodes.name: Moon Carver
nodes.base_description: An adeptus living in Jueyun Karst. One of the illuminated adepti.

nodes.name: Cloud Retainer
nodes.base_description: An adeptus who built Guizhong Ballista and designed mechanical abodes. Lives in Jueyun Karst.

nodes.name: Mountain Shaper
nodes.base_description: An adeptus residing on Mt. Hulao, plants karst crawlers to trap intruders.

nodes.name: Xiao
nodes.base_description: Conqueror of Demons, a Guardian Yaksha adeptus residing at Wangshu Inn.

nodes.name: Madame Ping
nodes.base_description: An elderly adeptus who guards the Cleansing Bell and lives near Yujing Terrace. Her teapot contains a domain.

nodes.name: Osial
nodes.base_description: Overlord of the Vortex, an ancient god defeated by Rex Lapis during the Archon War and pinned beneath Guyun Stone Forest.

states.current_description: Osial is trapped beneath Guyun Stone Forest, pinned by Rex Lapis's stone spears, dormant for over 2,000 years.
Osial is temporarily awakened by Childe and attacks Liyue Harbor. He damages the Guizhong Ballistas before being suppressed by the Jade Chamber.
Osial is suppressed again by the Jade Chamber's fall and retreats beneath the waves. His malice fades but he is not permanently destroyed.

nodes.name: Venti
nodes.base_description: The Anemo Archon, Barbatos, from Mondstadt.

nodes.name: Tsaritsa
nodes.base_description: The Cryo Archon, ruler of Snezhnaya, leader of the Fatui.

nodes.name: Verr Goldet
nodes.base_description: Boss of Wangshu Inn, knows about Xiao and adepti. She is secretly working with Ningguang as an informant.

nodes.name: Smiley Yanxiao
nodes.base_description: Chef at Wangshu Inn, formerly a bandit, afraid of ghosts. Makes Almond Tofu for Xiao.

states.current_description: Smiley Yanxiao is afraid of the ghost Dusky Ming and cannot cook Almond Tofu due to shaky hands.
Smiley Yanxiao is no longer afraid after Dusky Ming promises to stop haunting the inn. His hands become steady, and he makes perfect Almond Tofu.

nodes.name: Qiqi
nodes.base_description: A zombie child working at Bubu Pharmacy. Rescued by adepti after death. Has poor memory.

nodes.name: Baizhu
nodes.base_description: Owner of Bubu Pharmacy, wears medicinal ingredients around his neck. Accompanied by a talking snake, Changsheng.

nodes.name: Changsheng
nodes.base_description: A white, talking snake that hangs around Baizhu's neck.

nodes.name: Ying'er
nodes.base_description: Perfume maker at Scent of Spring. Helps Traveler and Zhongli extract Silk Flower essence to make perfumes for the Rite of Parting.

nodes.name: Shitou
nodes.base_description: Owner of Jade Mystery, a jade shop in Liyue Harbor. Sells Noctilucous Jade.

nodes.name: Iron Tongue Tian
nodes.base_description: Storyteller at Third-Round Knockout. Tells tales of Ningguang and the Jade Chamber.

nodes.name: Dusky Ming
nodes.base_description: A ghost girl residing at Wangshu Inn. Possesses a Ruin Hunter when scared. Xiao allows her to stay.

states.current_description: Dusky Ming haunts Wangshu Inn, scaring guests and staff, especially Chef Smiley Yanxiao, causing his hands to shake.
Dusky Ming promises to stop teasing travelers and agrees not to haunt the inn anymore after being comforted by the Traveler.

nodes.name: Guizhong
nodes.base_description: A historical adeptus, friend of Rex Lapis and Cloud Retainer. The Guizhong Ballista is named after her.

nodes.name: Liyue Qixing
nodes.base_description: The seven leaders of Liyue's seven enterprises, ruling over Liyue's mercantile affairs. Includes Ningguang and Keqing.

nodes.name: Fatui
nodes.base_description: Snezhnaya's military/diplomatic organization, led by the Tsaritsa. Harbingers include Signora and Childe.

nodes.name: adepti
nodes.base_description: Illuminated beings who fought with Rex Lapis to found Liyue and protect it. Include Cloud Retainer, Moon Carver, Mountain Shaper, Xiao, Ganyu, Madame Ping.

states.current_description: The adepti live secluded in Jueyun Karst, suspicious of the Qixing and demanding answers about Rex Lapis's death.
The adepti cooperate with the Qixing and Millelith to fight Osial. After witnessing Liyue's strength, they agree to step back and let humans govern the city.

nodes.name: Millelith
nodes.base_description: Liyue's military guard, loyal to the Qixing.

nodes.name: Treasure Hoarders
nodes.base_description: Bandits and thieves who operate in Liyue. Attempt to disable the Guizhong Ballista and capture Meng Dan.

nodes.name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
nodes.base_description: Liyue's funeral parlor that organizes burials. Zhongli works there as a consultant.

nodes.name: Bubu Pharmacy
nodes.base_description: Liyue's finest pharmacy, run by Baizhu with Qiqi as staff. Sells Everlasting Incense.

nodes.name: Liyue Harbor
nodes.base_description: The main city of Liyue, a prosperous port and commercial hub.

states.current_description: Liyue Harbor is peaceful, ruled by Rex Lapis and the Qixing. After Rex Lapis's apparent death, chaos and rumors spread.
Liyue Harbor is attacked by Osial. The Qixing, Millelith, and adepti defend the city. The Jade Chamber is sacrificed to save it.
Liyue Harbor is saved. The people learn Rex Lapis was not murdered. The Qixing takes full control now that the Geo Archon has retired.

nodes.name: Jueyun Karst
nodes.base_description: Mountainous region where the adepti dwell. Contains Mt. Hulao and Mt. Aocang.

nodes.name: Wangshu Inn
nodes.base_description: Inn near Dihua Marsh where Xiao stays and a ghost girl resides.

nodes.name: Golden House
nodes.base_description: The only mint in Teyvat, where Mora is created using the Geo Archon's power.

states.current_description: The Golden House is fully operational, minting Mora using Rex Lapis's power. The Exuvia is hidden here after the Rite of Descension.
The Golden House ceases operations for a lengthy period because creating Mora requires the Geo Archon's Gnosis, which has been given away.

nodes.name: Guyun Stone Forest
nodes.base_description: Stone forest formed by Geo spears thrown by Rex Lapis, pinning down Osial underwater.

nodes.name: Northland Bank
nodes.base_description: Fatui-operated bank in Liyue Harbor. Childe uses it as a base. The final revelation scene takes place here.

nodes.name: Dadaupa Gorge
nodes.base_description: A location in Mondstadt. Used to test Noctilucous Jade quality in a hilichurl cooking pot.

nodes.name: Wanmin Restaurant
nodes.base_description: Restaurant in Liyue Harbor where perfume is made using the kitchen.

nodes.name: Third-Round Knockout
nodes.base_description: A hole-in-the-wall tavern and eatery near Liyue Harbor, known for its wine and storytelling. Zhongli treats Traveler here.

nodes.name: Mt. Tianheng
nodes.base_description: A mountain in Liyue where the Guizhong Ballista is installed.

nodes.name: Dihua Marsh
nodes.base_description: A marshy area in Liyue where wild Glaze Lilies grow.

nodes.name: Jade Chamber
nodes.base_description: Ningguang's floating palace above Liyue Harbor, used as her office and residence. Sacrificed to suppress Osial.

states.current_description: The Jade Chamber floats above Liyue Harbor, serving as Ningguang's palace. It is constantly expanded and is her greatest treasure.
The Jade Chamber is destroyed, crashed onto Osial to suppress him. It no longer exists in the sky above Liyue.

nodes.name: Guizhong Ballista
nodes.base_description: An ancient adepti crossbow turret on Mt. Tianheng, built by Cloud Retainer, named after Guizhong. Repaired by Zhongli and used against Osial.

states.current_description: The Guizhong Ballista is broken and inoperable, disabled by Treasure Hoarders.
The Guizhong Ballista is repaired by Zhongli and used to search for the Cocogoat. Later, it is upgraded and used against Osial, but destroyed in the battle.
The Guizhong Ballista is destroyed during the battle with Osial and is no longer functional.

nodes.name: Exuvia
nodes.base_description: The vessel (dragon body) of Rex Lapis. Housed in the Golden House after the Rite of Descension.

nodes.name: Gnosis
nodes.base_description: Divine core of an Archon, given to the Tsaritsa by Zhongli as part of a contract.

states.current_description: The Gnosis is in Zhongli's possession, still part of his divine power as the Geo Archon.
The Gnosis is given to Signora and will be taken to the Tsaritsa in Snezhnaya.

nodes.name: Sigil of Permission
nodes.base_description: A talisman created by Rex Lapis that allows safe passage to adepti domains and can channel divine power. Fatui research copies.

nodes.name: Cleansing Bell
nodes.base_description: A bell used in the Rite of Parting to rid the deity of impurities. Guarded by Madame Ping.

nodes.name: Noctilucous Jade
nodes.base_description: A mystical jade used in the Rite of Parting. Quality is tested by heating and observing brightness.

nodes.name: Everlasting Incense
nodes.base_description: Incense bought from Bubu Pharmacy for the Rite of Parting, costing nearly 3 million Mora.

nodes.name: Glaze Lily
nodes.base_description: A flower that blooms to joyful sounds and withers with gossip. Wild ones are used for the Rite of Parting.

nodes.name: Almond Tofu
nodes.base_description: Xiao's favorite human food. Made by Smiley Yanxiao at Wangshu Inn.

nodes.name: coconut milk
nodes.base_description: Qiqi misremembers it as 'Cocogoat milk'. She desires it, leading to a contract with Childe.

nodes.name: Mora
nodes.base_description: The universal currency of Teyvat, minted in the Golden House using the Geo Archon's power.

nodes.name: Rite of Descension
nodes.base_description: Annual ritual where Rex Lapis descends to give divine predictions to Liyue.

nodes.name: fake death of Rex Lapis
nodes.base_description: Zhongli fakes his own death during the Rite of Descension, dropping his dragon body onto the altar.

nodes.name: Rite of Parting
nodes.base_description: Farewell ceremony for Rex Lapis, organized by Zhongli with Traveler's help.

nodes.name: preparation of Rite of Parting
nodes.base_description: Zhongli and Traveler gather materials: Noctilucous Jade, Silk Flower perfumes, Cleansing Bell, seven kites, Everlasting Incense, and wild Glaze Lilies.

base_attributes.time: after the Rite of Descension and before the Osial battle

nodes.name: perfume making
nodes.base_description: Ying'er helps Traveler extract essential oils from Golden House Maiden, Valley Weaver, and Fate's Yearning Silk Flowers to create three perfumes for the Rite of Parting.

nodes.name: Cocogoat misunderstanding
nodes.base_description: Qiqi sends Traveler and Zhongli to hunt a nonexistent 'Cocogoat' at the Guizhong Ballista. It turns out she meant coconut milk.

nodes.name: repair of Guizhong Ballista
nodes.base_description: Zhongli fixes the broken Guizhong Ballista using spare parts found in a supply post, then uses it to search for the 'Cocogoat'.

nodes.name: awakening of Osial
nodes.base_description: Childe uses multiple Sigils of Permission to temporarily break Rex Lapis's seals and unleash the ancient god Osial.

base_attributes.time: after the battle in the Golden House

nodes.name: battle at Jade Chamber
nodes.base_description: Humans (Qixing, Millelith) and adepti cooperate to fight Osial using upgraded Guizhong Ballistas.

nodes.name: sacrifice of Jade Chamber
nodes.base_description: Ningguang drops the Jade Chamber onto Osial to suppress him, ending the threat.

nodes.name: transfer of Gnosis
nodes.base_description: Zhongli gives his Gnosis to Signora as part of his contract with the Tsaritsa.

nodes.name: comforting of Dusky Ming
nodes.base_description: The Traveler finds the ghost girl Dusky Ming, listens to her, and convinces her to stop haunting Wangshu Inn.

base_attributes.time: during the visit to Wangshu Inn

nodes.name: sibling
nodes.base_description: The Traveler's lost sibling, whom the Traveler is searching for across Teyvat.

nodes.name: Yujing Terrace
nodes.base_description: The highest place in Liyue Harbor, where the Rite of Descension and Rite of Parting take place. The Jade Chamber floats above it.

nodes.name: Mt. Hulao
nodes.base_description: A mountain in Jueyun Karst where Mountain Shaper resides. Amber traps created by karst crawlers cover the area.

nodes.name: paper snow
nodes.base_description: Shredded documents from Ningguang's wall that contain intelligence. One sheet reveals Fatui research on the Sigil of Permission.

nodes.name: Fatui research site
nodes.base_description: A hidden location where the Fatui copy and research Sigils of Permission, discovered by the Traveler using the paper snow clue.

nodes.name: Meng Dan
nodes.base_description: A supplier for Mingxing Jewelry who searches for antiques in the mountains. Rescued by the Traveler from Treasure Hoarders.

edges.description: Traveler is accompanied by Paimon as a guide and companion.
Traveler receives guidance from Paimon about Liyue customs and directions.
The Traveler fights Childe in the Golden House to protect the Exuvia and stop him from taking the Gnosis.
Childe pretends to help the Traveler while secretly planning to steal the Gnosis.
Traveler helps gather jade, make perfume, borrow the Cleansing Bell, obtain kites and incense, and collect Glaze Lilies for the ceremony.
The Traveler's main goal is to find their lost sibling, which is why they seek all seven Archons.
Zhongli asks the Traveler to help organize the Rite of Parting, offering a meal as compensation.
Traveler follows Childe to the Golden House to confront him and protect the Exuvia.
The Traveler calms Dusky Ming and convinces her to stop haunting the inn.
The Traveler receives an invitation to meet Ningguang at the Jade Chamber.
The Traveler presents Sugar-Frosted Slime as a greeting gift to Ningguang.
The Traveler gets the invitation to the Jade Chamber via Ganyu.
The Traveler meets Keqing while investigating the ballista.
As a reward, the Traveler takes a sheet of 'paper snow' from Ningguang's wall.
Using the paper snow clue, the Traveler finds and investigates a Fatui research site copying Sigils of Permission.
The Traveler encounters Moon Carver in Jueyun Karst.
The Traveler meets Mountain Shaper after freeing Li Dang from amber.
The Traveler meets Cloud Retainer inside her abode on Mt. Aocang.
The Traveler finds Xiao at Wangshu Inn after being sent by Moon Carver.
The Traveler encounters Madame Ping near Yujing Terrace.
The Traveler defeats the Treasure Hoarders and frees Meng Dan.
The Traveler gets a gift box from Meng Dan.
The Traveler attempts to sing to wild Glaze Lilies to make them bloom, but attracts Whopperflowers instead.
Paimon accompanies the Traveler as their guide and floating companion.
Paimon explains Liyue customs, traditions, and helps navigate the region.
Zhongli is the mortal identity of Rex Lapis, the Geo Archon.
Zhongli hands over his Gnosis to Signora as part of his contract with the Tsaritsa.
Zhongli stages his own death during the Rite of Descension to test Liyue's readiness.
Zhongli purchases Noctilucous Jade from Shitou's Jade Mystery for the Rite of Parting, often forgetting to bring Mora.
Zhongli repairs the ancient Guizhong Ballista using spare parts found in a supply post.
Zhongli buys a meal for the Traveler at Third-Round Knockout as thanks for their help.
Zhongli recruits the Traveler to help with the Rite of Parting preparations.
Zhongli arranges the entire Rite of Parting, from gathering materials to performing the ceremony.
Zhongli made a 'contract to end all contracts' with the Cryo Archon, exchanging his Gnosis.
Zhongli explains how to evaluate Noctilucous Jade quality by heating it and observing brightness.
Madame Ping sends word through the Traveler that Zhongli can come for tea anytime.
Zhongli takes the Traveler to eat at the Third-Round Knockout tavern.
Zhongli is a consultant for Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.
Zhongli arranges the purchase of Everlasting Incense from Bubu Pharmacy.
Rex Lapis takes the mortal form of Zhongli.
Rex Lapis founded Liyue 3,700 years ago together with the adepti.
Rex Lapis entered into contracts with the adepti for Liyue's protection.
As Geo Archon, Rex Lapis can create Mora, and the Golden House mints it using his power.
Rex Lapis defeated Osial during the Archon War and pinned him under stone spears.
Rex Lapis defeated Osial during the Archon War and pinned him under stone spears.
Rex Lapis possesses the Gnosis until he gives it away as part of his contract with the Tsaritsa.
Childe is the Eleventh Harbinger of the Fatui.
Childe battles the Traveler in the Golden House after suspecting they took the Gnosis.
Childe acts friendly and helpful while secretly planning to steal the Gnosis and awaken Osial.
Childe uses multiple Sigils of Permission to temporarily break Rex Lapis's seals and unleash Osial.
Childe wields multiple Sigils of Permission to awaken Osial.
The Fatui, led by Childe, research and duplicate Sigils of Permission at a hidden site.
Childe provides Mora to pay for all Rite of Parting materials, unaware of Zhongli's true identity.
Childe uses Northland Bank as his base in Liyue for Fatui operations.
Childe conducts Sigil of Permission research at Northland Bank.
Childe breaks into the Golden House to steal the Gnosis from the Exuvia.
Childe agrees to provide coconut milk to Qiqi in exchange for a discount on Everlasting Incense.
Childe offers Fatui distribution network to Bubu Pharmacy.
Childe enters the Golden House to find and take the Gnosis from the Exuvia.
Ningguang is the Tianquan, a member of the Liyue Qixing.
Ningguang drops the Jade Chamber onto Osial to suppress him and save Liyue.
Ningguang orders the Exuvia to be hidden away after the Rite of Descension to control the situation.
After the Osial battle, Ningguang uses Childe's attack as diplomatic leverage against the Fatui envoys.
Ningguang spies on Fatui activities in Liyue and limits their movements.
Ningguang commands the Millelith to seal the exits and arrest suspects.
Ningguang uses Verr Goldet as an informant.
Ningguang sends Ganyu to formally invite the Traveler to the Jade Chamber.
Ningguang accepts the gift offered by the Traveler.
Ningguang's deeds are told by Iron Tongue Tian.
Keqing investigates the repair of the Guizhong Ballista.
Keqing encounters the Traveler at the Guizhong Ballista.
Ganyu is the secretary of the Qixing and serves as Ningguang's emissary.
Ganyu picks wild Glaze Lilies and gives them to Traveler for the Rite of Parting.
Ganyu acts as Ningguang's emissary to invite the Traveler.
Signora takes the Gnosis from Zhongli at Northland Bank.
Previously in Mondstadt, Signora took Venti's Gnosis.
Signora serves the Tsaritsa as a Fatui Harbinger.
Signora takes the Geo Archon's Gnosis as part of the contract with the Tsaritsa.
Moon Carver instructs Traveler to go to Wangshu Inn to find the Conqueror of Demons, Xiao.
Cloud Retainer constructed the Guizhong Ballista using adeptus technology.
Cloud Retainer grants the Traveler an audience after completing her domain puzzle.
Mountain Shaper planted karst crawlers on Mt. Hulao to trap intruders.
Mountain Shaper confronts the Traveler on Mt. Hulao for freeing Li Dang.
Xiao asked the innkeepers to let Dusky Ming stay at Wangshu Inn because she has never hurt anyone.
Xiao, the Conqueror of Demons, resides at Wangshu Inn, often found on the balcony.
Almond Tofu is Xiao's favorite human food.
Xiao appears on the balcony of Wangshu Inn and speaks with the Traveler.
Madame Ping allows Traveler to borrow the Cleansing Bell from her teapot domain for the Rite of Parting.
Madame Ping tells Traveler to invite Zhongli for tea at her place.
The Traveler meets Madame Ping while she tends to Glaze Lilies.
Osial is unleashed from beneath Guyun Stone Forest by Childe's actions.
Osial remains trapped beneath the sea at Guyun Stone Forest, held by Rex Lapis's stone spears.
Venti's Gnosis was taken by Signora.
The Cryo Archon, Tsaritsa, negotiated with Zhongli to obtain his Gnosis.
The Tsaritsa is served by Signora, who acts as her agent.
The Tsaritsa acquires the Geo Archon's Gnosis through Signora's collection.
Verr Goldet is the boss of Wangshu Inn and employs Smiley Yanxiao as chef.
Verr Goldet secretly reports to Ningguang about Traveler and others.
Smiley Yanxiao works under Verr Goldet at Wangshu Inn.
Smiley Yanxiao prepares Almond Tofu for Xiao.
Smiley Yanxiao is afraid of the ghost at Wangshu Inn.
Qiqi is a zombie employee at Bubu Pharmacy.
Qiqi resides and works at Bubu Pharmacy.
Qiqi's poor memory leads her to ask for a 'Cocogoat', creating a comedic misunderstanding.
Qiqi works under Baizhu at Bubu Pharmacy.
Qiqi's desire for coconut milk leads to a deal with Childe.
Baizhu is the owner of Bubu Pharmacy.
Baizhu is the owner and pharmacist at Bubu Pharmacy.
Baizhu is the boss of Bubu Pharmacy and Qiqi works for him.
Baizhu agrees to a future collaboration with the Fatui for coconut milk supply.
Changsheng, the talking white snake, is always with Baizhu, often around his neck.
Yinger guides Traveler in extracting essential oils and making three perfumes for the Rite of Parting.
Iron Tongue Tian tells stories, including tales of Ningguang and the Jade Chamber, at Third-Round Knockout.
The storyteller narrates tales of Ningguang and her Jade Chamber.
Dusky Ming, a ghost girl, scares staff and guests at Wangshu Inn until Traveler calms her.
The ghost girl scares Smiley Yanxiao, causing his hands to shake.
Dusky Ming listens to the Traveler and agrees to behave.
The Qixing hold true control over Liyue Harbor's mercantile and civil affairs.
The Qixing publicly announce that Rex Lapis died due to a failed divine trial, not murder, after learning he is not truly dead.
The Fatui employs Childe as the Eleventh Harbinger.
The Fatui are under surveillance by Ningguang.
The Fatui, through Harbingers like Childe and Signora, seek to obtain the Geo Archon's Gnosis.
The adepti have a contract to protect Liyue, which they uphold during the Osial crisis.
The adepti signed contracts to protect Liyue under Rex Lapis.
The adepti live in and guard the Jueyun Karst, preventing intruders from entering.
The Millelith are the military force that guards Liyue Harbor under the Qixing's command.
The Millelith follow Ningguang's orders during the crisis.
The Millelith obey Ningguang's commands.
Millelith soldiers are stationed at the Jade Chamber.
Treasure Hoarders previously disabled the Guizhong Ballista to access hidden treasures.
Treasure Hoarders capture and imprison Meng Dan in ruins.
Wangsheng Funeral Parlor employs Zhongli as a consultant.
Bubu Pharmacy is Qiqi's home and workplace.
Bubu Pharmacy is where Baizhu practices medicine.
Bubu Pharmacy sells Everlasting Incense, with Baizhu offering a discount after Childe's deal.
Liyue Harbor is run by the Qixing, with Ningguang as Tianquan and Keqing as Yuheng.
Liyue is defended by the illuminated adepti who signed contracts with Rex Lapis.
Liyue Harbor was established by Rex Lapis 3,700 years ago.
Jueyun Karst is the protected domain of the adepti.
The Golden House is the only mint in Teyvat where Mora is produced using the Geo Archon's power.
The Golden House is where Childe confronts Traveler and searches for the Gnosis.
Traveler enters the Golden House to confront Childe.
Guyun Stone Forest is where Osial is released from his imprisonment.
Guyun Stone Forest marks where Rex Lapis defeated Osial.
Northland Bank is where the Gnosis exchange occurs.
Northland Bank houses the Fatui's research on the Sigil of Permission.
Northland Bank is the location where the Gnosis changes hands from Zhongli to Signora.
Dadaupa Gorge is where the quality of Noctilucous Jade is assessed.
Wanmin Restaurant's kitchen is used for perfume production.
Third-Round Knockout serves as the place where Zhongli treats Traveler.
The Jade Chamber is destroyed by Ningguang to save Liyue.
The Jade Chamber floats in the sky above Yujing Terrace.
The Jade Chamber is the location from which Osial is fought.
The Jade Chamber has Millelith guards.
The Guizhong Ballista is installed on Mt. Tianheng.
During the battle, the upgraded Guizhong Ballistas, manned by adepti, fire upon Osial.
The Guizhong Ballista was created by Cloud Retainer.
The Guizhong Ballista draws Keqing's attention after being repaired.
The Exuvia is kept secret on Ningguang's orders.
Before the Rite of Parting, the Exuvia is temporarily kept in the Golden House.
The Exuvia is an empty vessel; the Gnosis was never inside it.
The Gnosis is handed over to Signora by Zhongli at Northland Bank.
The Gnosis originally belonged to Rex Lapis as his divine core as the Geo Archon.
The Gnosis is given to the Tsaritsa as part of Zhongli's 'contract to end all contracts'.
Childe searches the Exuvia in the Golden House but finds no Gnosis inside.
The Gnosis provides the Geo Archon's power needed to mint Mora at the Golden House.
The Gnosis is a target for the Fatui, who collect Archons' Gnoses for the Tsaritsa.
The Gnosis is handed over to Signora inside Northland Bank.
The method to test Noctilucous Jade is taught by Zhongli.
Noctilucous Jade is tested for quality at Dadaupa Gorge.
Everlasting Incense is purchased from Bubu Pharmacy for the Rite of Parting, costing nearly 3 million Mora.
Everlasting Incense is burned during the Rite of Parting ceremony to honor Rex Lapis.
Everlasting Incense is bought by Zhongli with Traveler's help and Childe's funding.
Wild Glaze Lilies can be found in Dihua Marsh.
The Glaze Lily is picked by Ganyu and given to Traveler.
The Glaze Lilies are sung to by the Traveler but the real flowers have been replaced by Whopperflowers.
Almond Tofu is made by the chef at Wangshu Inn.
